HOS means Hours of Service. These are th: HOS macnaheedu waa Saacadaha Adeegga. Kuwani waa xeerarka inta aad wadi karto oo aad shaqeyn karto ka hor intaadan nasan.
ETA means the time we think you will get: ETA macnaheedu waa waqtiga aan u malaynayno inaad gaadhayso.
POD means proof of delivery. It is the p: POD macnaheedu waa caddeynta keenista. Waa warqad ama sawir muujinaya inaad dejisay xamuulka.
BOL means bill of lading. It is the pape: BOL macnaheedu waa warqadda xamuulka. Waa warqadda liis garaysa waxa aad qaadayso iyo cidda uu u yahay.
CDL means commercial driver's license. Y: CDL macnaheedu waa liisanka wadista ganacsiga. Waxaad u baahan tahay si aad u wado gaari xamuul weyn.
ELD means electronic logging device. It: ELD macnaheedu waa qalabka diiwaanka elektaroonigga ah. Waa sanduuqa ama barnaamijka haya diiwaankaaga wadista ee sharciga ah.
OTR means over the road. You drive long: OTR macnaheedu waa safar dheer oo waddo ah. Waxaad wadaa safarro dhaadheer waxaadna guriga ka maqan tahay maalmo.
Hazmat means dangerous goods, like fuel: Hazmat macnaheedu waa alaab khatar ah, sida shidaal ama kiimiko. Waddooyin iyo tunnel-o qaar ma oggola.
A reefer is a trailer or van with a cool: Reefer waa tareelo ama faan leh qaboojiye xamuulka qabow ku haya.
Bobtail means driving the truck with no: Bobtail macnaheedu waa wadista gaariga xamuulka adigoon tareelo lahayn.
PO means purchase order. It is the numbe: PO macnaheedu waa amarka iibsiga. Waa lambarka uu diraha xamuulku u isticmaalo xamuulkan.
